children: A Polymarket submarket tied to the LOUD vs. FURIA Esports CBLOL playoff match saw the probability of the “Yes” option for both teams killing one dragon swing sharply from 99.95% one hour earlier to 50%.
According to ChainCatcher, the move represented a 49.95% fluctuation, and users were advised to watch for the impact of breaking news on related markets.

title: Polymarket LoL Submarket Drops From 99.95% to 50% Amid CBLOL Playoff Match
